items.name: Cube Against Cancer Franklin 2026
items.information:
**This competition is a part of the [Cube Against Cancer](https://www.cubeagainstcancer.org/) competition series in collaboration with [Ethan's Ohana](https://www.ethansohana.org/). We are asking that all competitors bring at least one unopened 3x3 cube or STEM-related item, which will be donated to a pediatric cancer patient. See the [Cube Against Cancer](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/CACFranklin2026#67811-cube-against-cancercubeassociation.org) tab for more information.**

This competition is supported by [Southeast Cubing, Inc.](https://southeastcubing.org/about), the official nonprofit organization for speedcubing in the Southeast! Please check out the [Southeast Cubing, Inc. tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/CACFranklin2026#67812-southeast-cubing-inc) to learn more about the organization and what you can do to support the mission.

items.name: West Coast Cubing Western Championship 2026

venue.name: [The Riverside Convention Center](https://riversidecvb.com/riverside-convention-center/)
venue.details: Ben H. Lewis Hall - Exhibit Hall A and B

items.information:
## West Coast Cubing welcomes you to Riverside for Western Championship 2026!

![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTQ2NjQzLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--cf643f8826077f011ac9001e0e28d1f7cb4b8b45/WesternsLogo%20-%20Edited.png)

### **Please visit the [Key Information](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/WesternChampionship2026#66525-key-information) tab for an overview of everything Western Champs 2026!**

The highest-placing competitor from the Western Region in each event at this competition will be recognized as the Western Champion! Check out the [Eligibility tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/WesternChampionship2026#66534-western-champion-eligibility) for more information.

This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). If you are new to competing, please refer to the New Competitor section on the [FAQ](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/WesternChampionship2026#66527-faq) tab.

Spectators can attend for free and can come and go as they please! No registration or check-in process is needed for spectating.

This competition is organized by [West Coast Cubing](https://www.westcoastcubing.com/) and supported by our [sponsors](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/WesternChampionship2026#66533-sponsors).

items.name: Nordic & Swedish Championship 2026
items.information:
![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTIzNjU4LCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--a5235948e002bc4f499657630eeb0b8e823b34f9/NM_long.png)

Welcome to the Nordic & Swedish Championship 2026!

We are very excited to welcome you all to IFU Arena in Uppsala - the venue which will host the World Championship 2027.

Everyone is welcome to participate, whether you solve the cube in 5 seconds or 5 minutes. We ask you to read through all the tabs on this page as they contain very valuable information.

-----

Välkomna till det Nordiska & Svenska Mästerskapet 2026! 

Vi är mycket glada över att välkomna er alla till IFU Arena i Uppsala – arenan som kommer att stå värd för VM 2027.

Alla är varmt välkomna att delta, oavsett om du löser kuben på 5 sekunder eller 5 minuter. Vi ber er läsa igenom alla flikar på denna sida eftersom de innehåller mycket värdefull information.


[![](https://cuboss.se/wp-content/uploads/2024/01/cuboss-svekub-loggor.png)](https://svekub.se/om_oss/svekub-cuboss/)
